reviews.text: Dear Thawhouse: during the Christmas blizzard our kitchen line froze solid. Maggie talked me through shutting the main over the phone, then got here once the plows came through and found the split behind the sink.
reviews.name: Colleen D.

reviews.text: Same pipe froze three winters running. Instead of thawing it again they moved it off the outside wall into the warm side of the basement. Haven't had to call since.
reviews.name: Mike K.

reviews.text: We own a double on the West Side and never knew which shut-off fed which flat. They traced every line, labeled both meters and both heaters, and drew it on a card we keep by the stairs.
reviews.name: Aisha N.

reviews.text: Battery backup on the sump was the smartest thing we did. Power went out during the spring thaw and the backup ran for hours. The pit never came over the edge.
reviews.name: Dave P.

reviews.text: Outside spigot split in the cold and nobody noticed until spring. They replaced it with a frost-free one and showed me how the shut-off sits inside the house where it stays warm.
reviews.name: Linda S.

reviews.text: The morning after the storm they couldn't get to us until afternoon, the roads weren't plowed. They called every couple of hours to keep me posted, and the thaw was careful once they arrived.
reviews.name: Joe R.
